title: Seals Delight Compat
description: Adds brand new Seals (player titles) for the Seals Mod based on Farmer's Delight advancements!
body:
# Seals Delight Compat
Seals Delight Compat is a datapack adds compatibility between [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and [Seals](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/seals)! 

## Details
Adds **two** additional Seals that players can earn by completing Farmer's Delight advancements!

### Gatherer
Earned by completing four advancements related to harvesting crops and one for fishing.

### Master Chef
Earned by completing two secret advancements. 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
One requires you to eat every placeable meal, and the other requires you to obtain a netherite knife.
</details>

## Usage
- Ensure you have both [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and [Seals](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/seals) installed
- Copy the .zip to both the datapack folder and your resourcepack folder
- Ensure the .zip in the resourcepack folder is enabled (if you see "seals.exampletitlename" when hovering over the seal, it is not enabled)
- Recommended: [Global Packs](https://modrinth.com/mod/globalpacks) (or similar alternatives) to simplify the process
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
The Global Packs method is the method I use personally. I keep the datapack in my resourcepack folder and enable it so the lang file shows the appropriate titles.
</details>
